name: Dadera
text: Dadera is a variant spelling of the name Do Dera. Do Dera is the fool killed by Eógan in the early tales. No separate entry carries the Do Dera form, so this record keeps the pointer to the killer. Readers should follow the Eógan entry for that figure and his deeds.

attributes.attribute: a variant spelling of Do Dera

okr.objective: Record Dadera as the variant spelling of Do Dera, the fool slain by Eógan.
key_results: Dadera is a variant spelling of Do Dera.
The fool Do Dera dies at the hands of Eógan.
